title: Evidence Batch → CWA Admission → RRE Candidate → Position Human Review
purpose: Execute auditable current-evidence batches without auto-populating dossiers that do not have verifiable sources.
candidateRules: Every evidence reference used by a candidate must be CWA-admitted in the same auditable batch result.
All W7 required evidence lanes for the dossier must be admitted before a position candidate can enter human review.
Unresolved CWA evidence conflicts block candidate generation.
RRE readout lineage must exist before canonical position mapping.
Candidate input supplies grammarId and realityDomainId; W8 maps that pair to the 48-position canon and does not accept a raw phase/date shortcut.
Candidate generation never equals position admission; humanDecision remains PENDING until owner review.
No production batch is created merely to fill the 12 dossiers.
fixturePolicy: Fixture batches may exercise the machine pipeline only in FIXTURE mode and are rejected in PRODUCTION mode.
